lead: What to send, what you get back and how long it takes. Then a button that links to your form.
note: The element shows only the panel and the button. It has no form fields and collects no data.

steps.title: What you send
steps.text: List exactly what a useful enquiry needs.

steps.title: What happens next
steps.text: Many panels leave this out, but it helps readers decide to get in touch.

steps.title: What comes back
steps.text: Say whether it is a document, a call or a price.

steps.title: How long the offer is valid
steps.text: Without a date, people have to ask again.

image.alternative: One person hands over a set of keys and a stack of papers at a front door.
